title: Cobblemon: Mega Raichu Ability Patch
description: A datapack for Navas ZA Megas that changes Mega Raichu's abilities to the ones in champions.
body:
This datapack add-on for [Navas ZA Megas](https://modrinth.com/datapack/navas-zamega) changes Mega Raichu X's and Mega Raichu Y's abilities to the ones confirmed to soon be in Pokémon Champions.

- Mega Raichu X's ability is changed to Electric Surge
- Mega Raichu Y's ability is changed to No Guard

Required Mods:
- [Cobblemon](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon)
- [Cobblemon: Mega Showdown](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-mega-showdown)
- [Navas ZA Megas](https://modrinth.com/datapack/navas-zamega)
